name: Medical Bay
narrativeOnEnter: Cold, white, sterile. Navigation override panel on the counter — biometric scanner offline, manual switches live.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA — ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC
Life Support Power Reroute — Emergency Procedure

To restore life support power:
1. Open the engineering junction panel
2. Match wire connections:
   Red   → Junction A
   Blue  → Junction D
   Green → Junction B
   Yellow→ Junction C

Note: This reroutes power from secondary systems.
Command deck blast doors will unseal upon completion.

CREW STATUS — MERIDIAN ALPHA

CHEN, Y.   — EVACUATED
KOVALEV, D. — UNKNOWN (Reactor Deck)
PATEL, S.  — EVACUATED
DIAZ, M.   — EVACUATED

Kovalev remained to attempt reactor stabilisation.
If he failed — cascade in ~30 minutes.

Defibrillator on the wall. Charged. Hopefully not needed.
